discoveries.mechanism: AQR canonical managed-futures replica: equal-weighted 1-, 3- and 12-month time-series momentum, each position vol-scaled, rebalanced monthly, across FX/metals/energy/softs/indices/bonds. 21/63/252 trading days are the paper's 1/3/12 months. min_agreement 0.6 = at least 2 of 3 speeds agree (the family's vote proxy for the equal-weight sum).
discoveries.source_title: A Century of Evidence on Trend-Following Investing (Hurst, Ooi, Pedersen), AQR
discoveries.quote: we construct an equal-weighted combination of 1-month, 3-month, and 12-month time series momentum strategies for 59 markets

discoveries.mechanism: Pure 12-month TSMOM: long if trailing 12m excess return >0 else short, sized to constant ex-ante vol, one-month hold. Paper's vol estimator is EWMA of squared daily returns with centre of mass 60 days (vol_window 60 is the closest rolling analogue). Trend persists ~1 year then partially reverses, so do NOT extend lookback beyond 12m.
discoveries.source_title: Time Series Momentum (Moskowitz, Ooi, Pedersen), JFE
discoveries.quote: This time series momentum or ‘‘trend’’ effect persists for about a year and then partially reverses over longer horizons.

discoveries.mechanism: Momentum turning points: classify each month by sign of 12m (slow) and 1m (fast) trailing return into Bull/Correction/Bear/Rebound. When slow and fast disagree (Correction/Rebound) the trend inference is unreliable and an intermediate speed dominates; crisis_only restricts entries to disagreement months, the paper's high-information state.
discoveries.source_title: Momentum Turning Points (Goulding, Harvey, Mazzoleni), JFE
discoveries.quote: When slow and fast momentum disagree, we call it a “Correction” state if slow momentum indicates a long position

discoveries.mechanism: Crisis-alpha speed: Man AHL finds convexity and worst-quintile S&P performance rise as trend speed increases (slow trend cannot flip short within a 1-3 month review window, e.g. Q1 2020). Fast trend on equity indices is the defensive leg; expect lower after-cost Sharpe, positive skew.
discoveries.source_title: The Need for Speed in Trend-Following Strategies, Man Group
discoveries.quote: Performance during equity weakness is still best with faster trading

discoveries.mechanism: Bond crisis alpha: trend on government bonds made money both in the 1960-mid-1980s bond bear market and the post-1985 bull; payoff is best in the worst bond AND worst equity environments ('bond smile'). Apply the 1/3/12m blend to UST10Y/UST05Y/UKGILT CFDs.
discoveries.source_title: Trend Following: Equity and Bond Crisis Alpha (Hamill, Rattray, Van Hemert), Man Group
discoveries.quote: Strategy performance is best in the worst equity and worst bond environments

discoveries.mechanism: Out-of-sample trend: AQR's Trends Everywhere tests 12-month TSMOM on 82 new instruments incl. emerging-market currencies; alternative assets delivered a higher gross Sharpe (1.34) than traditional (1.17). Man's market-mix work likewise finds EM currency pairs among diversifying 'esoteric' markets. Apply to Fusion EM FX (costs/swap will be the binding constraint).
discoveries.source_title: Trends Everywhere (Babu, Levine, Ooi, Pedersen, Stamelos), JOIM
discoveries.quote: the strategy delivers an even higher Sharpe ratio of 1.34 for the alternative assets

discoveries.mechanism: Winton/Man/Transtrend all report that universe choice (esoteric and smaller commodity markets, iron ore, palm oil, cocoa) drives more of trend return dispersion than the trading rule. Extend the 1/3/12 blend to every softs and base-metal CFD rather than the liquid core only.
discoveries.source_title: Transtrend: How to profit from trends?
discoveries.quote: The choice of the investment universe may be a more decisive factor for individual programs' returns than the choice of the trading systems used.

discoveries.mechanism: Currency carry = interest-rate differential (expected return if spot unchanged). KMPV find carry predicts returns in every asset class (SR 0.6-0.9 each; 1.5 diversified) but all carry books lose together in global recessions/liquidity crises -- hence keep the family's quiet-market gate. Fusion swap differential is the desk's model-free carry measure.
discoveries.source_title: Carry (Koijen, Moskowitz, Pedersen, Vrugt), JFE
discoveries.quote: a carry trade within each asset class earns an annualized Sharpe ratio between 0.6 to 0.9

discoveries.mechanism: Commodity carry = slope of futures curve (backwardated markets favoured). On CFDs the broker's long/short swap embeds the roll, so a positive-swap side is a proxy for backwardation (mapping SPECULATED; the commodity result is DOCUMENTED: equal-risk commodity index 7.9% vs 1.5% in backwardation vs contango).
discoveries.source_title: Commodities for the Long Run (Levine, Ooi, Richardson, Sasseville), NBER/FAJ
discoveries.quote: commodity indices, such as the equal risk-weighted one, earn 7.9 % versus 1.5% in periods of backwardation versus contango

discoveries.mechanism: Carry-crash risk: speculators hold net long positions in high-carry currencies; those positions raise crash (negative skew) risk and unwind abruptly. Fade multi-year extreme CFTC speculative positioning in carry currencies (AUD, NZD, MXN long; JPY/CHF short).
discoveries.source_title: Carry Trades and Currency Crashes (Brunnermeier, Nagel, Pedersen), NBER Macro Annual
discoveries.quote: speculators’ positions increase crash risk

discoveries.mechanism: Cross-sectional momentum within commodities (VME): rank instruments on past 12-month return (paper skips the most recent month; this family cannot skip -- see gap), long the top quintile, short the bottom, monthly. 6048 = 252 days x 24 H1 bars; ttl 504 = one month.
discoveries.source_title: Value and Momentum Everywhere (Asness, Moskowitz, Pedersen), JF
discoveries.quote: the return over the past 12 months skipping the most recent month

discoveries.mechanism: Cross-sectional 12-month momentum across currencies (VME currencies leg). Note quote-convention: USDxxx instruments rank on their own tradable return, which is valid for an instrument-level panel.
discoveries.source_title: Value and Momentum Everywhere (Asness, Moskowitz, Pedersen), JF
discoveries.quote: We skip the most recent month, which is standard in the momentum literature, to avoid the 1-month reversal in stock returns

discoveries.mechanism: Cross-sectional momentum across country equity index CFDs (VME country-index leg): long past-12m winners, short losers, monthly rebalance.
discoveries.source_title: Value and Momentum Everywhere (Asness, Moskowitz, Pedersen), JF
discoveries.quote: A combination of value and momentum—one of the themes in this paper—obtains nearly identical pricing results

discoveries.mechanism: Betting-against-beta applied to country equity indices: BAB computes index betas vs a GDP-weighted world portfolio; low-beta indices (levered) beat high-beta. BAB returns are low when funding constraints tighten (TED spread up), so pair with a funding-stress read.
discoveries.source_title: Betting Against Beta (Frazzini, Pedersen), JFE
discoveries.quote: When funding constraints tighten, the return of the BAB factor is low

discoveries.mechanism: The style_premia trend score with speeds set to AQR's 1/3/12 months in H1 bars (21/63/252 days x 24) instead of the family's intraday default (24,120,480 bars = 1/5/20 days), which Winton shows to be the decayed speed. Daily decision, vol-normalised, clipped at +-3.
discoveries.source_title: Historical Performance of Trend Following, Winton Capital working paper
discoveries.quote: we see a significant decline in the performance of the fastest strategies even before transaction costs are accounted for

discoveries.mechanism: Man AHL crisis-proofing: time-series momentum and quality/defensive are the two dynamic strategies positive before costs that also paid in all eight equity drawdowns, with negligible mutual correlation. Test the existing trend_x_defensive combo on index CFDs as the crisis sleeve.
discoveries.firm: Man AHL (Harvey, Hoyle, Rattray, Sargaison, Taylor, Van Hemert)
discoveries.source_title: The Best of Strategies for the Worst of Times: Can Portfolios Be Crisis Proofed? (Man AHL/Duke), JPM
discoveries.quote: Time-series momentum strategies add to winning positions (ride winners) and reduce losing positions (cut losers)

discoveries.mechanism: Man's FX work: carry (interest differential) information improves returns and adding 12-month FX trend raises the Sharpe; AQR shows carry and momentum both positive with low correlation. Test the 50/50 carry x momentum combo on G10 and liquid EM FX.
discoveries.firm: Man Group (Castro, Hamill, Harber, Harvey, Van Hemert)
discoveries.source_title: The Best Strategies for FX Hedging (Castro, Hamill, Harber, Harvey, Van Hemert; Man Group), JPM
discoveries.quote: incorporating additional factors—such as trend (12-month FX return), value (deviation from purchasing power parity), and carry

discoveries.mechanism: Carry is harvested in calm and crashes when global risk (VIX) spikes: a VIX rise coincides with speculator unwinds and carry losses. Condition carry on low realised vol (the desk's calm-vol combo is the price-only proxy of the VIX gate).
discoveries.source_title: Carry Trades and Currency Crashes (Brunnermeier, Nagel, Pedersen), NBER Macro Annual
discoveries.quote: a higher level of VIX predicts higher returns for invest- ment currencies and lower returns for funding currencies

discoveries.mechanism: AQR tests 196 buy-the-dip variants on the S&P 500 since 1965 and finds no robust alpha vs buy-and-hold; trend (SG Trend) alpha 4.7% vs BTD 0.3%. Registered as a FALSIFICATION test: dip-buying after a 10% drawdown from the 12m high on index CFDs is expected to FAIL the gauntlet -- a pass would contradict AQR.
discoveries.source_title: AQR Alternative Thinking 2025 Issue 4: Hold the Dip
discoveries.quote: history shows it’s better to align with momentum than to buy the dip, by following the trend

discoveries.mechanism: In equity bear markets AQR's trend book ends up long gold against cyclical commodities and short carry currencies. Gold-vs-copper spread dislocations: tested here as the single-leg residual fade (relative_value) -- the mechanism predicts the spread TRENDS in crises, so a fade failing in drawdowns is informative.
discoveries.source_title: Tail Risk Hedging: Contrasting Put and Trend Strategies, AQR
discoveries.quote: anti-carry currencies, and buying gold against more cyclical commodities

discoveries.mechanism: Man: the post-2000 negative stock-bond correlation is a historical rarity, so bonds are an unreliable crisis hedge; Man's Regimes model uses the 3-year stock-bond correlation as a state variable. Trade the breakdown of the equity-bond correlation regime.
discoveries.source_title: The Best of Strategies for the Worst of Times: Can Portfolios Be Crisis Proofed? (Man AHL/Duke), JPM
discoveries.quote: the post-2000 negative bond– equity correlation is a historical rarity

discoveries.mechanism: Man vol-targeting: risk assets show a leverage effect (negative return-vol relation), so vol-scaling adds momentum; the flip side is that post-spike vol mean-reverts. Registered to measure whether index vol compression precedes expansion on MT5 CFDs.
discoveries.source_title: The Impact of Volatility Targeting (Harvey, Hoyle, Korgaonkar, Rattray, Sargaison, Van Hemert), JPM
discoveries.quote: volatility scaling effectively introduces some momentum into strategies

discoveries.mechanism: Pension 60/40 rebalancing: calendar rebalancers sell equities at month-end after equities outperform; the paper finds calendar predictability strong at month-end, absent otherwise. This unconditional short-bias version is a weak proxy -- the real signal is conditional on month-to-date equity-vs-bond outperformance (see capability gap).
discoveries.source_title: The Unintended Consequences of Rebalancing (Harvey, Mazzoleni, Melone), NBER WP 33554
discoveries.quote: Calendar predictability is strong at month-end but absent at other times

discoveries.mechanism: Breaking bad trends: turning points (fast and slow momentum disagree) destroy monthly trend P&L; more turning points per year explain the 2009-2019 CTA drought. Test whether the desk's hazard-based regime-exit signal captures the rebound/correction breaks that GHM show are forecastable.
discoveries.source_title: Breaking Bad Trends (Goulding, Harvey, Mazzoleni), FAJ
discoveries.quote: a turning point for an asset as a month in which its slow (longer lookback horizon) and fast (shorter lookback horizon) momentum signals differ

discoveries.mechanism: Winton medium EWMA-crossover system (~6-week turnover, positions scaled by inverse 20-day EWMA vol) had the best 30-year Sharpe (1.12) of fast/medium/slow; anchor the entry on the daily (24 x H1) 50-period trend to stay in the medium speed band.
discoveries.source_title: Historical Performance of Trend Following, Winton Capital working paper
discoveries.quote: The Sharpe ratios (SR) are 0.87, 1.12, and 0.81 for the fast, medium, and slow strategies respectively
